description: This file contains a shell script that tests various git worktree functionalities, including reference management, reflogs, and ref resolution for multiple worktrees and worktrees within directories.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit, possibly in a given directory, used within tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a block of commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares the revisions of two references to verify they are equal.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after tests are completed for cleanup.
